conditions: Signed-in customer navigates to Account > Orders & Payment > Order History (/#/order-history)
items.expected: The navigation succeeds and the order history page is displayed; each past order is listed with its order number and total amount

conditions: Signed-in customer clicks the track order button for one of their past orders
items.expected: The tracking view opens and shows that order's status and its products

conditions: Signed-in customer views the order history page
Orders shown on the page belong only to the currently signed-in user (not orders from other accounts)
items.expected: Only orders placed by the signed-in customer are listed; no orders from other accounts appear

conditions: Unauthenticated user (not signed in) attempts to navigate directly to /#/order-history
items.expected: Access is denied and the user is redirected away from the order history page; the page does not render order data

conditions: Unauthenticated user attempts to track an order by its number via the tracking URL
Signed-in customer A's order number is submitted in a tracking request by a different user or an unauthenticated session
items.expected: Order tracking is restricted: only the owning customer can track their own order; an unauthenticated or different-user request is denied

conditions: Signed-in customer is on the order history page (/#/order-history)
axe-core scans the main content area with WCAG A and AA rules
items.expected: No accessibility violations are reported (violations.map(v => v.id).sort() equals [])

excluded.reason: Session token surviving logout is a cross-cutting session-management concern not specific to order history or order tracking; SCRUM-27 covers only what a customer sees in their order history and when tracking an order, not what happens to their session after logout
